title: Fantasy Football: 2026-27 Top 5 Scoring RBs
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if the named running back finishes the 2026-27 NFL regular season (Weeks 1 through 18) ranked among the top 5 running backs by total fantasy points under standard PPR (points-per-reception) scoring per the default scoring of ESPN Fantasy Sports. Otherwise, that market will resolve to "No".

Only regular-season games count; postseason (playoff) games are excluded. If two or more running backs are tied such that more than 5 would qualify for the top 5, the tie will be broken by higher fantasy points per game average for the 2026 NFL regular season, and if a tie still persists, by last name in alphabetical order, so that exactly 5 running backs are classified as top 5.

If the 2026-27 NFL regular season is cancelled, postponed past January 26, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, or the rankings cannot be determined within this timeframe, all markets in this event will resolve to "No".

The resolution source will be official season-total statistics as reported by ESPN Fantasy Sports (https://www.espn.com/fantasy/).

This market will resolve in favor of the player that finishes the 2026-27 NFL regular season with the most interceptions thrown.

In the event of a tie, this market will resolve in favor of the tied player with a higher interception percentage (interceptions thrown divided by pass attempts) during the 2026-27 NFL regular season. If a tie still persists, this market will resolve in favor of the player with fewer passing touchdowns during the 2026-27 NFL regular season. If a tie still persists, this market will resolve to "Other".

If the 2026-27 NFL season concludes early, is shortened, or is truncated for any reason, the outcome shall be determined using available NFL statistics for completed games.

If the 2026-27 NFL regular season is cancelled, postponed after January 26, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, or it is unclear which player led the NFL in interceptions thrown within that timeframe, this market will resolve to "Other".

The resolution source for this market will be official information from the NFL; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

title: Fantasy Football: 2026-27 TE Points Per Game (PPR)
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if the listed player's average fantasy points per game during the 2026-27 NFL regular season (Weeks 1 through 18) equals or exceeds the listed number under standard PPR (points-per-reception) scoring per the default scoring of ESPN Fantasy Sports. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

Average fantasy points per game is the player's total PPR fantasy points for the 2026-27 NFL regular season divided by the number of regular season games in which the player appeared, as reported by ESPN Fantasy Sports. Only regular season games count; postseason (playoff) games are excluded. There is no minimum number of games played. If the listed player does not appear in any 2026-27 NFL regular season game, this market will resolve to "No".

If the 2026-27 NFL regular season is cancelled, postponed past January 26, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, or the per-game averages cannot be determined within this timeframe, this market will resolve to "No".

The resolution source will be official season statistics as reported by ESPN Fantasy Sports (https://www.espn.com/fantasy/).

title: How many NFL Scorigamis in the 2026-27 regular season?

This market will resolve to "Yes" if the number of NFL Scorigamis that occur during the 2026-27 NFL regular season equals or exceeds the listed number. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

The 2026-27 NFL regular season covers all games from Week 1 through Week 18. Each game whose final score is a Scorigami counts as one Scorigami toward the total, including games played before this market opened. This market may resolve to "Yes" as soon as the listed number of Scorigamis has occurred.

If any 2026-27 NFL regular season game is canceled, or is postponed beyond February 14, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve based on the final scores of all completed regular season games.
